properties.description: SQL Script to attach raw view of northern re's vellum data.

content.query:
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [developmentdls] WITH
(
	LOCATION = 'https://developmentdls.blob.core.windows.net/development-data-lake'
);
GO

CREATE SCHEMA [raw];
GO

CREATE VIEW [raw].[financial_model_inputs] AS
SELECT 
	[query_date] = COALESCE([query_date], CONVERT(datetime2, A.filepath(3))),
	[statement_id] = [statement_id],
	[status] = [status],
	[v_created] = [v_created],
	[nre_feed] = [nre_feed], -- A.filepath(1)
	[treaty_year] = [treaty_year], -- CONVERT(tinyint, A.filepath(2))
	[bordereaux_month] = [bordereaux_month],
	[tf_assumed_gross_written_premium] = [tf_assumed_gross_written_premium],
	[tf_assumed_earned_premium] = [tf_assumed_earned_premium],
	[tf_assumed_paid_losses] = [tf_assumed_paid_losses],
	[tf_assumed_expected_losses] = [tf_assumed_expected_losses],
	[tf_assumed_collected_premium] = [tf_assumed_collected_premium],
	[tf_assumed_ss] = [tf_assumed_ss],
	[tf_assumed_paid_alae] = [tf_assumed_paid_alae],
	[tf_assumed_paid_ulae] = [tf_assumed_paid_ulae],
	[adm_nonadm_indicator] = [adm_nonadm_indicator],
	[is_admitted] = [isAdmitted],
	[program_admin] = [program_admin]
FROM
	OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'bronze/northernre/treefrog_snapshots/*/*/*.parquet',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'developmentdls',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    )
	WITH (
		query_date DATETIME2,
		statement_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		[status] NVARCHAR(100),
		v_created DATE,
		nre_feed NVARCHAR(100),
		treaty_year TINYINT,
		bordereaux_month DATE,
		tf_assumed_gross_written_premium MONEY,
		tf_assumed_earned_premium MONEY,
		tf_assumed_paid_losses MONEY,
		tf_assumed_expected_losses MONEY,
		tf_assumed_collected_premium MONEY,
		tf_assumed_ss MONEY,
		tf_assumed_paid_alae MONEY,
		tf_assumed_paid_ulae MONEY,
		adm_nonadm_indicator NVARCHAR(100),
		isAdmitted BIT,
		program_admin NVARCHAR(100)
	) A
WHERE A.filepath(2) NOT LIKE '%-%-%-%-%'
;
GO
